snippet.title: Absolum | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Absolum will launch onto PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 on October 9!

Wishlist it now and experience its demo before Absolum comes out: https://playabsolum.com/

Unveiling Absolum's fourth playable character: Brome, a Mowlai (humanoid frog) born with magical prowess.
Brome’s moveset draws from his species’ spiritual education, using his staff for melee combos, ranged and AoE spellcasting, and – of course – hoverboard-style gliding. 

Brome joins Cider, Galandra, and Karl in the fight against the deadly Sun King and his Crimson Order!

Absolum blends arcade-like melee combat with spells, counters, upgradable abilities, and uniquely powerful playable fighters, hosting a grand, high-stakes quest across an array of hand-crafted stages.
With its fast-paced action and endless replayability, Absolum will challenge you with multiple paths to explore and unpredictable encounters for a new experience each time you play.
